definitions.gloss: good-looking person, attractive person, beautiful features
definitions.explanation: A person with beautiful or well-proportioned facial features. Can refer to both men and women, though often implies a refined, classical beauty rather than mere cuteness. Also used as a na-adjective to describe someone as good-looking.

examples.japanese: あの{俳優|はいゆう}は{美形|びけい}だ。
{美形|びけい}の{兄弟|きょうだい}がそろっていて{羨|うらや}ましい。
examples.english: I'm envious that the siblings are all good-looking.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{美形|びけい}なだけでなく、{性格|せいかく}も{良|よ}いので{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: He is popular not only because he is good-looking but also because he has a good personality.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as both a noun (a good-looking person) and a na-adjective (good-looking). Often used in entertainment, anime, and manga contexts. Implies well-proportioned, refined features rather than just attractiveness. Applicable to both genders but often used for men with refined features.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美人|びじん}: beautiful person (usually female)
- {イケメン}: handsome man (casual, modern)
- {美男|びなん}: handsome man (more formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美形|びけい}の{俳優|はいゆう}: good-looking actor
- {美形|びけい}キャラ: good-looking character (anime/manga)
